newsitem.title: POLAND: Zloty gains ground vs basket in volatile trade.
newsitem.headline: Zloty gains ground vs basket in volatile trade.

text.p: The zloty firmed against the basket of currencies after large intraday swings caused by the U.S. dollar's losses in European trade and small-scale foreign investor sales of Polish treasuries, dealers said.

They said the volatile zloty finally found strong support from the falling dollar, whose nearly two figure fall against the mark since this morning triggered currency sales on the domestic forex market.
"The zloty sharply gained after the dollar fell against the mark at the end of today's session," said Pawel Gajewski, forex dealer at Creditanstalt in Warsaw.
Overnight rates closed at 21.60/21.80 percent against the opening's 21.40/21.75 percent, tomorrow/next rates were at 21.60/21.75 percent against 21.40/21.75 percent.
